title: cota coelopoda var. bourgaei
intro: Cota coelopoda var. bourgaei, commonly known as the Bourgae's Cota, is a plant species within the family Asteraceae. This plant has been traditionally used to treat various health issues, including its potential to lower blood pressure and exhibit anti-inflammatory properties, which may contribute to its therapeutic actions in reducing fever and pain. The Bourgae's Cota contains bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties. However, more research is needed to fully understand the health benefits and therapeutic actions of this plant, but it is often used to support digestive health and immune system function.
